title: Crispy Aloo Tikki
description: A popular North Indian street food made with crispy potato patties served with a side of chutney.
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine the mashed potatoes, chopped onion, grated ginger, cumin powder, coriander powder, amchur powder, and salt. Mix well.
2. Divide the mixture into 6-8 portions, depending on how large you want your patties to be.
3. Shape each portion into a round patty.
4. Heat a non-stick pan with a small amount of oil over medium heat.
5. Once the oil is hot, add the patties and cook for about 4-5 minutes on each side, or until they are golden brown and crispy.
6. While the patties are cooking, toast the flatbread by grilling it on a pan or baking it in the oven for a few minutes.
7. Once the patties are done, place them on a serving plate with the toasted flatbread.
8. Serve the crispy aloo tikki with a side of chutney.
9. Garnish with a sprinkle of amchur powder and a squeeze of lemon juice, if desired.
